branches.rejected: 9-13px type fails the 390px one-handed test; invented labels (Net Liquidity, VAMI.INDEX) the app does not use

/portfolio.activeDirection: editorial, type-led — SHIPPED. Portfolio carries value and the period change only. Draft synced to the implementation at v7: range buttons text-xs (not 10px pills), headline 34px on the phone stepping to 42px at md:.
notes: The code is the source of truth for this target now; it is implemented. Sync the draft to the code, not the other way round, unless deliberately exploring a change.
Versions 4-7 are hand-authored imports, not generations: all three generations dropped content they were told to keep.

/insights.activeDirection: performance only — benchmark comparison, by-period table, allocation, contributors, activity. Accounting figures deliberately excluded.

/ledger.activeDirection: new screen: cost basis, unrealised, realised, fees, cash; net invested per year; value on a date (box 3); cash by currency.
/ledger.openQuestion: navigation — no route exists yet; tab bar holds four and adding a fifth is a real cost. Candidates: behind More, or replacing Chart.

conventions.timeframes: One canonical list in src/lib/ranges.ts. Screens offer a subset via RangePicker's `only` prop — never a second list. Everyday periods (1D 1W 1M 1Y All) stay inline; the rest collapse behind More on a phone and sit inline from md: up. The selected period never collapses.
conventions.importCaveat: import-design-draft rejects `{}` in inline handlers as an unresolved JSX expression. Write brace-free JS (arrow bodies without braces).
conventions.chartAxes: Price axis only where the level is read. Portfolio value and the Insights comparison hide it; the asset price chart keeps it with axisMoney() compact labels.
